title: Sharplink pillars
description: A long list of principles beside a tall media slot pinned on the right: each item is a narrow label, a two-line title and a short paragraph, lit up while it crosses the middle of the window (its title's letters brighten in a scattered order) and dimmed otherwise; the pinned media crossfades to the item being read. Down the section the paper turns pale blue, then saturated blue, then black, and the text turns light with it.
notes: items from `darkFrom` on sit on the dark band and use the theme's dark colours (.dark)
one media slot per item: pinned on the right on wide screens (crossfading by named view timelines, timeline-scope), under each item on phones
without view-timeline support or with reduced motion: the first item's media stays, every item is at full strength
transparent at the top: on the page it shows the Sharplink backdrop wash
name: sharplink-pillars
